cards.text: Pull up a stool, friend. This story starts with Elkanah, a man from Ramathaim-zophim in the hill country of Ephraim. He has two wives, Hannah and Peninnah.

cards.question: Elkanah has two wives, Hannah and Peninnah. Which one has children?

cards.text: Year after year, Elkanah goes up from his city to worship and sacrifice to the LORD of Hosts at Shiloh. The priests there are Hophni and Phinehas, the two sons of Eli the priest.
On the day of his sacrifice, Elkanah hands out portions to Peninnah and to all her sons and daughters.

cards.question: Elkanah loves Hannah, even though the LORD has closed her womb. So on sacrifice day, he gives Hannah a ___ portion.

cards.text: But Hannah has a rival, and this rival doesn't just roll her eyes. She provokes Hannah viciously.

cards.question: Hannah's rival taunts her because Elkanah gives Hannah a double portion.
Year after year, whenever Hannah goes up to the house of the LORD, her rival taunts her. What does Hannah do?

answers.text: She weeps and will not eat
She taunts her rival right back
She asks Elkanah to send her away

cards.text: Elkanah sees her crying and asks, "Am I not better to you than ten sons?" Friend, that's like me telling a baker crying over a burnt batch, "Cheer up, at least you've got ME!"
After they finish eating and drinking in Shiloh, Hannah stands up. Meanwhile Eli the priest is sitting on a chair by the doorpost of the temple of the LORD.

cards.question: In her bitter distress, Hannah weeps with many tears as she prays to the LORD.

cards.text: Then she makes a vow to the LORD of Hosts. She asks Him to look on her affliction, remember her and give her a son.

cards.question: In her vow, Hannah says what she'll do if the LORD gives her a son. What is it?

answers.text: Dedicate him to the LORD for life
Name him after his father Elkanah
Throw a feast for all of Shiloh

cards.question: Hannah also vows that no razor will ever touch her son's head.

cards.text: Hannah keeps praying in her heart. Her lips are moving, but her voice can't be heard, and Eli is watching her mouth.

cards.question: Eli sees Hannah's lips moving with no sound coming out. He thinks she is ___.

cards.text: And Eli says it out loud: "How long will you be drunk? Put away your wine!" Friend, I mumble at my oven timer all day long, and NOBODY has ever asked to check my breath.

cards.question: Eli thinks Hannah has been drinking. What does Hannah tell him she's really been doing?

answers.text: Pouring out her soul before the LORD
Waiting for her husband to come back

cards.question: Hannah explains she's been praying out of deep anguish and grief. What does Eli say to her now?

answers.text: Go in peace and may God grant your request
Come back and pray again here tomorrow
Go home and wait for another year

cards.question: After Eli's words, Hannah begins to eat again, and her face is no longer downcast.

cards.text: The next morning, the family gets up early, bows in worship before the LORD, and heads home to Ramah.

cards.question: In her vow, Hannah prayed for the LORD to remember her. Back home in Ramah, the LORD remembers Hannah.

cards.text: In the course of time, Hannah gives birth to a SON! I'm hopping up and down on my gold base so hard my chef's hat just flew off.

cards.question: Hannah names her boy Samuel. What reason does she give for the name?

answers.text: She asked the LORD for him
Eli the priest picked it out

cards.text: Then Elkanah and his whole house go up to make the annual sacrifice to the LORD and to fulfill his vow. But this time, Hannah doesn't go.

cards.question: Hannah stays home from the trip. She tells Elkanah she'll take the boy to appear before the LORD after he is ___.
Hannah plans to bring the boy before the LORD for a short visit and then bring him back home.
Hannah wants to stay home until the boy is weaned. How does Elkanah answer her?

answers.text: He tells her to do what she thinks best
He tells her the boy must go now
He asks Eli to decide for them

cards.text: So Hannah stays home and nurses her son until he's weaned. Then, though he's still young, she takes him to the house of the LORD at Shiloh with a three-year-old bull, an ephah of flour and a skin of wine.

cards.question: At Shiloh, they slaughter the bull. Then they bring the boy to ___.

cards.text: Hannah tells Eli, "I am the woman who stood here beside you praying to the LORD." That's right, friend, the same woman he told to put away her wine.

cards.question: Hannah reminds Eli she's the woman who prayed here. What does she tell him about this boy?

answers.text: The LORD gave her what she asked
An angel promised him to her
He was born on a feast day

cards.text: So she dedicates the boy to the LORD for as long as he lives, and they worship the LORD right there. Year after year of tears, friend, and she kept her word.
At that time, Hannah prays again. Lean in for this one, friend.

cards.question: When Hannah prayed for a son at Shiloh, she was in bitter distress. What does she say her heart does now?

cards.text: She says, "There is no one holy like the LORD." And there's no Rock like our God.

cards.question: Then Hannah's prayer warns against proud boasting. What reason does she give?

answers.text: The LORD knows and weighs actions
Proud words will cost them land

cards.text: Then her prayer starts flipping things upside down. The bows of the mighty are broken, but the feeble are equipped with strength.

cards.question: The flips keep coming. What happens to the barren woman?

cards.text: She keeps going: the LORD brings death and gives life. He brings down to Sheol and raises up.

cards.question: Hannah says the LORD sends both poverty and wealth.

cards.text: He raises the poor from the dust and lifts the needy from the ash heap. Friend, I spent years under the dust in the back of a junk drawer, so I KNOW what that lift feels like!

cards.question: Once the LORD lifts the poor and needy, what place does He give them?

answers.text: A throne of honor among princes
A servant's job at the temple
A quiet spot back where they started

cards.question: Hannah says a man can prevail by his own strength.
Hannah says the LORD will thunder from heaven against those who oppose Him. What will happen to them?

cards.text: And she closes with this: the LORD will judge the ends of the earth, give power to His king and exalt the horn of His anointed. That's a big finish from a woman who used to cry so hard she wouldn't eat.

cards.question: Elkanah heads home to Ramah. What is young Samuel doing?

answers.text: Ministering to the LORD before Eli

cards.text: And that's where we leave him for now, a little boy serving the LORD. Keep your apron on, friend, because this story is just getting started.
